title: Year
definition:
Returns the year component from a date value.
The function extracts the four-digit year (for example: 2026) from the provided date column.

title: Month
definition:
Returns the month component from a date value.
The function extracts the numeric month (1–12) from the provided date column, where 1 represents January and 12 represents December.

title: Day
definition:
Returns the day of the month from a date value.
The function extracts the numeric day (1–31) representing the day within the month of the provided date.

title: Week
definition:
Returns the week number of the year for a given date.
The function extracts the numeric week (1–53) indicating the position of the date within the year.

title: Day of week
definition:
Returns the day of the week for a given date.
The function extracts the numeric representation of the weekday, indicating the position of the day within the week.

title: Day of year
definition:
Returns the day number within the year for a given date.
The function extracts the numeric position of the date in the year, ranging from 1 to 365 (or 366 in leap years).

title: Semester
definition:
Returns the current semester of the year based on the current month.
The function divides the year into two semesters:

- Semester 1 → January to June (month ≤ 6)
- Semester 2 → July to December (month > 6)

title: Quarter
definition:
Returns the quarter of the year for a given date.
The year is divided into four quarters, each covering three months:

- Quarter 1 → January to March
- Quarter 2 → April to June
- Quarter 3 → July to September
- Quarter 4 → October to December
The function extracts the month from the date and returns the corresponding quarter number (1–4).

title: YearSemester
definition:
Returns the year and semester for a given date.
The semester is determined based on the month of the date:

- Semester 1 → January to June
- Semester 2 → July to December
The function combines the year and the semester number into a single value.

title: YearQuarter
definition:
Returns the year and quarter for a given date.
The quarter is determined based on the month of the date:

- Quarter 1 → January to March
- Quarter 2 → April to June
- Quarter 3 → July to September
- Quarter 4 → October to December
The function combines the year and the quarter number into a single value.

title: YearMonth
definition:
Returns the year and month extracted from a date value.
The result is formatted as YYYY-MM, combining the four-digit year and the numeric month.

title: MonthDay
definition:
Returns the month and day extracted from a date value.
The result is formatted as MM-DD, representing the numeric month followed by the day of the month.

title: YearWeek
definition:
Returns the year and week number extracted from a date or timestamp.
The result is formatted as YYYY-'W'WW, combining the year with the corresponding week of the year.

title: Hour
definition:
Returns the hour component from a time or timestamp value.
The hour is extracted using the 24-hour format, ranging from 0 to 23.

title: Minute
definition:
Returns the minute component from a time or timestamp value.
The extracted value ranges from 0 to 59.

title: Second
definition:
Returns the second component from a time or timestamp value.
The extracted value ranges from 0 to 59.

title: hourMinute
definition:
Returns the hour and minute extracted from a time or timestamp value.
The result is formatted as HH:MM using the 24-hour time format.

title: Epoch
definition:
Returns the Unix epoch time for a given date or timestamp.
The value represents the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970 (UTC).
